# Workshop AI

> Workshop AI is a Melbourne-based AI implementation consultancy that helps Australian tradies and trade, service and industrial businesses put AI to work in the office, with fixed prices and hands-on delivery.

Workshop AI Pty Ltd, ABN 63 698 704 915. Founded 2026. Director: Justin Watts. Based in Hobsons Bay, in Melbourne's western suburbs, Victoria. In person across Melbourne, remote Australia-wide. Contact: hello@workshopai.com.au, 0431 254 769. Last updated 14 October 2026.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://workshopai.com.au/): what Workshop AI does, the five-level path, a client example and prices
- [Company facts](https://workshopai.com.au/facts/): who Workshop AI is, who it serves, services, prices, people and service area
- [AI for tradies: questions answered](https://workshopai.com.au/ai-for-tradies/): 58 answers on using AI in an Australian trade or service business

## Services (AUD, excluding GST)

- Claude for Owners: A$1,500 (Two one-on-one video sessions). AI set up on the owner's desk first: Claude connected to files, email and calendar, a company-wide Claude Project with the business's context, and a one-page guide to using it safely with client information. Credited in full if the business goes further within 60 days.
- Claude for Business: A$2,500 (Set up and running within a week). The team on Claude properly: set up for nominated staff, connected to everyday tools, a shared company-wide Claude Project, AI standards and governance, a team intro session and a follow-up two weeks later. Credited in full towards Discovery within 60 days.
- Discovery: A$3,600 (Four stages, about a month). A complete picture of how the business really works before any tool is recommended: AI standards and governance, a written AI use policy, a systems audit and confidential team survey, a workflow map, a scored AI Opportunity Map, and a findings report with a recommended pathway.
- Custom Builds: From A$4,400 a month (Monthly retainer or fixed-price project). Custom AI agents and automations built into the job, file and accounting systems the business already runs, one defined piece at a time with a clear definition of done. Month to month, no lock-in.
- Document Standard: A$2,000 as an add-on, A$2,750 on its own (Two weeks). Up to four client-facing documents (quotes, reports, letters) built into Claude in the business's own format, wording and branding, with two rounds of revisions. A$2,000 as an add-on or A$2,750 on its own; A$4,000 for Claude for Business and Document Standard booked together.
